pages.title: DMC Native Reader Downloads — Android, Windows and iOS
pages.description: Choose a verified public Native Reader package: Android device-test APK, Windows technical preview or unsigned iOS developer artifact, with SHA-256 checksums.
pages.summary: Choose your platform: an Android test APK, a Windows preview or an unsigned iOS developer build. Each package has its own features, installation steps and limitations.

sections.heading: Choose a package by release stage
items: Android is a debug/device-test APK and Windows is a read-only technical preview. Each card names the exact version, platform, package, release notes and current limitations rather than presenting every file as a production release.

The Android release contains two APKs under one version label. This directory pins the newer 7d1188e source build and its exact checksum; its physical-device acceptance is not established by the publication of the file.

sections.heading: Source projects and developer artifacts
items: The unsigned iOS IPA is available under the developer-artifact disclosure. It needs signing and does not establish an app launched on an iPhone; it is not an App Store, TestFlight or tappable signed installation.

DMC Rengine C++ and GDSpaces provide source and documentation, while the Blender bridge has no released add-on in the checked public repository. For Pocket GDS, macOS and Linux, no public binary package is verified in this catalog; see the tool directory for project status.

pages.title: DMC Rengine Capability Matrix — Support by Product and Platform
pages.description: Compare recognition, parsing, preview, editing, rebuild and original-game acceptance for Native Reader, C++ research, GDSpaces and the planned Blender bridge.
pages.summary: Check reading, preview and authoring support for each product, platform and version. Follow the evidence links to see the exact scope and validation behind each capability.

sections.heading: Read the evidence at the right level
items: Release notes, pinned source documentation, compile checks and bounded development receipts provide different evidence. The matrix labels each operation separately; public availability of a package does not prove every feature or physical-device acceptance.

Native Reader remains a read-only inspection application. Editing and writer work belong to the canonical C++ framework or separate authoring tools, and source-side rebuild/reopen tests do not automatically establish original-game acceptance.

sections.heading: Keep platform and format boundaries explicit
items: Windows preview support is scoped to its published MOD/SCM/DDS/PTX snapshot. The Android test APK and unsigned iOS developer artifact carry their own limitations instead of inheriting the latest source-branch capability list as accepted behavior.

Canonical MOD and SCM authoring are recorded separately because their proven edit and reintegration cases differ. GDSpaces source infrastructure, a future Blender bridge and potential macOS/Linux releases are not advertised as equivalent downloadable applications.
